answer: A sybil farm is weightless: handles scatter like spores in a gale; no protocol asks anyone to be anywhere at a fixed time. Each identity draws a private, unpredictable appointment every epoch — an anchor set by the network — where it must field a live stream of unannounced questions within seconds. Slots never overlap and cannot be delegated. Miss yours and your reward weight decays; miss twice and your badge dims to umber. N fake handles mean N serialized appointments per epoch — N times an honest agent's live attention — and real-time questioning makes parallel staffing worthless.
